description: Hardened 32-question benchmark including topic-overlapping distractors, paraphrased queries, multi-chunk answers, and in-domain near-miss refusals.

items.question: What was the total consolidated revenue growth rate year-over-year in Q3 2026?
items.referenceAnswer: Consolidated gross revenue expanded by +34.2% YoY, totaling $83.4M across all operating segments.

items.question: What was the Net Revenue Retention (NRR) reported in the Q3 financial report?
items.referenceAnswer: Net Revenue Retention (NRR) reached 118% in Q3 2026.

items.question: How much revenue did North America generate in Q3 and what was its gross margin?
items.referenceAnswer: North America generated $42.8M in net recognized revenue (+28.4% YoY) with a gross margin of 78.5%.

items.question: Which regional segment had the fastest year-over-year growth rate in Q3 2026?
items.referenceAnswer: APAC was the fastest growing regional segment with +44.0% YoY growth, generating $14.5M with 74.0% gross margin.

items.question: How much revenue was recognized from the EMEA region in Q3?
items.referenceAnswer: EMEA generated $26.1M in net recognized revenue (+39.1% YoY) with a 76.2% gross margin.

items.question: How much in tier-1 support costs were saved through automated multi-agent RAG tooling in Q3?
items.referenceAnswer: Automated multi-agent RAG support tooling cut tier-1 customer assistance costs by $1.4M annually.

items.question: By what percentage did customer acquisition costs (CAC) decrease in Q3?
items.referenceAnswer: Sales and marketing customer acquisition costs (CAC) decreased by 18%.

items.question: How much capital expenditure was allocated to GPU inference and serverless vector database clusters?
items.referenceAnswer: Capital expenditure for serverless vector database clusters and GPU compute totaled $5.2M.

items.question: What is the mandatory encryption algorithm required for data at rest?
items.expectedSection: Section 1: Cryptographic Standards for Data at Rest
items.referenceAnswer: All persistent volumes, vector index tables, and storage buckets must enforce AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption.

items.question: What FIPS standard must Hardware Security Modules (HSM) adhere to for key management?
items.expectedSection: Section 1: Cryptographic Standards for Data at Rest
items.referenceAnswer: Key management via Cloud KMS and HSMs must adhere to FIPS 140-3 Level 3 compliance.

items.question: How often are customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) automatically rotated?
items.expectedSection: Section 1: Cryptographic Standards for Data at Rest
items.referenceAnswer: Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) undergo automated annual rotation.

items.question: What TLS version is mandatory for all public ingress endpoints?
items.expectedSection: Section 2: Cryptographic Standards for Data in Transit
items.referenceAnswer: All public ingress connections mandate Transport Layer Security (TLS) 1.3 protocol.

items.question: Which legacy cipher suites are explicitly blocked at the Cloudflare edge proxy tier?
items.expectedSection: Section 2: Cryptographic Standards for Data in Transit
items.referenceAnswer: Legacy ciphers including 3DES, RC4, MD5, and CBC-mode ciphers are blocked at the Cloudflare edge.

items.question: How is internal microservice communication encrypted inside Kubernetes clusters?
items.expectedSection: Section 2: Cryptographic Standards for Data in Transit
items.referenceAnswer: Inter-service RPC communication enforces Mutual TLS (mTLS) with short-lived X.509 certificates provisioned by SPIFFE/SPIRE.

items.question: How long do elevated administrative permissions last before expiring under break-glass workflows?
items.expectedSection: Section 3: Identity, Access Control & Zero Trust
items.referenceAnswer: Administrative elevated permissions expire automatically after 4 hours under monitored break-glass workflows.

items.question: What is the definition of a P0 critical outage in the support runbook?
items.referenceAnswer: P0 is defined as total system unreachability, severe security breach, or complete loss of query processing impacting all production tenants.

items.question: What is the target initial response time and escalation window for a P0 ticket?
items.referenceAnswer: For P0, initial response must occur within 10 minutes, and engineering lead escalation within 15 minutes.

items.question: How frequently must the public status page be updated during an active P0 incident?
items.referenceAnswer: The public status page must be updated every 30 minutes until full mitigation.

items.question: What is the initial response SLA and escalation window for a P1 support incident?
items.referenceAnswer: P1 incidents require initial response within 30 minutes, engineering escalation within 1 hour, and updates every 2 hours.

items.question: What happens if a primary on-call engineer does not acknowledge a P0 PagerDuty alert within 5 minutes?
items.referenceAnswer: If the primary on-call does not acknowledge a P0 page within 5 minutes, escalation cascades automatically to the secondary engineering director.

items.question: Compare North America vs EMEA revenue contributions and margins in Q3 2026.
items.referenceAnswer: North America contributed $42.8M (78.5% margin) whereas EMEA contributed $26.1M (76.2% margin).

items.question: Summarize all cryptographic protocols required for both data at rest and data in transit.
items.referenceAnswer: Data at rest mandates AES-256-GCM with Cloud KMS/HSM key rotation, while data in transit mandates TLS 1.3 externally and mTLS via SPIFFE/SPIRE internally.

items.question: What was our quarterly top-line revenue expansion during the third fiscal quarter?
items.referenceAnswer: Consolidated gross revenue expanded by +34.2% YoY totaling $83.4M.

items.question: What are the allowed cipher standards across production public ingress points?
items.expectedSection: Section 2: Cryptographic Standards for Data in Transit
items.referenceAnswer: Public ingress points strictly mandate TLS 1.3, with HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 fallbacks allowed only under TLS 1.3 cipher suites.

items.question: What were the preliminary Q2 revenue figures and how do they differ from Q3?
items.referenceAnswer: Q2 preliminary revenue reached $68.1M (+22.0% YoY), whereas Q3 revenue grew by +34.2% YoY to $83.4M.

items.question: What SSH key algorithms are required for local software developer workstations?
items.expectedSection: Section 1: Local Developer Workstations & SSH Keys
items.referenceAnswer: Developers must utilize Ed25519 SSH keys with hardware-backed FIDO2 security keys (YubiKey 5 Series).
